title: NDS owned screen control definitions
$comment: Protocol17/Core75250 contract for existing ScreenStore callers; schema/DTO generation does not authenticate, publish runtime capability or grant OS capture consent. Rust-only control messages; keys/grants/frames stay outside presentation and synchronization.

InstanceId.description: Canonical lowercase non-nil UUID. Generate once per owned endpoint instance, retain across lost-ACK retries; a new instance uses a new UUID even with the same protected purpose key. Decode to exactly16 UUID bytes for Core PoP V2.

ViewId.description: Canonical server-created unique view id, never reused after End/restart; native grant tenant equals this id.

NativeGrant.description: Canonical unpadded base64url of1..8192 opaque native grant bytes. Rust control I/O only; never Dart/Flutter, URLs, logs, sync, telemetry or a permission assertion. Decode with the byte bound and re-encode equality; RDS separately verifies real native signature and exact Core context.

ScreenBinding.description: Current canonical binding, stored only after current NDS enrolled-device authority AND native endpoint PoP; metadata alone is not permission.

ScreenBindingResponse.description: Required null means the authenticated same-owner active target has no screen binding; it never creates an identity or authorizes capture.

ScreenBindRequest.description: Register only the signing enrolled device. A new UUID CASes current base and increments revision even samekey. Same current UUID/key/original base returns original binding AFTER fresh nonce consumption and both proof checks. Changed key/base or superseded original base conflicts.

nonce.description: Exact nonce from THIS existing NDS HTTP Signature-Input context. Refresh signature/nonce/expiry/endpoint proof on retry while retaining instance/key/original base.

expires_at_ms.description: Unix milliseconds, exact JSON-safe integer. Equals THIS HTTP Signature-Input expires seconds multiplied by1000; future<=60000ms and within current NDS session expiry.

signature.description: Endpoint-key Ed25519 PoP over Core NDS-RDS-ENDPOINT-BINDING-V2 transcript: configured origin, signing device id, decoded endpoint key, instance UUID bytes, original base revision, exact signed nonce/expiry. Not the NDS enrolled-device HTTP signature.

ScreenViewRequest.description: Signing device is viewer; target is an active same-owner host. Current exact distinct endpoint bindings and original viewer session are checked atomically. Requested lifetime<=300000ms; accepted expiry is explicitly returned at whole seconds. Exact original request bytes determine idempotent create replay; never renew/resurrect an old intent.

expires_at_ms.description: Unix milliseconds, exact JSON-safe integer. Requested upper bound,<=300000ms from actual admission and within current viewer session expiry; accepted whole-second boundary is explicitly returned.

ScreenView.description: Public immutable Core projection; no creator session digest, owner authority, key material, locator, capabilities, frames or capture consent. Original admission/expiry/profile survive replay/expired reconstruction. Ready means stored native artifact, not received/decoded/presented pixels; ended/expired metadata cannot reopen a host.

admitted_at_ms.description: Unix milliseconds, exact JSON-safe integer. ORIGINAL canonical admission timestamp; retain on replay/expired reconstruction.

expires_at_ms.description: Unix milliseconds, exact JSON-safe integer. ORIGINAL accepted whole-second expiry; no renewal or restored lifetime.

ScreenIncoming.description: Current signed host role sees at most one participant intent; no list/paging/cache/registry. Actual local opt-in/current Accounts fence/platform source access are still required before native capture.

ScreenViewResponse.description: Viewer-only current authorized delivery. Recheck original viewer session, both active participant rows and exact bindings before delivering Rust-only grant; cached metadata/grant never permits reopen.

ScreenReadyRequest.description: Signed host role submits exact original opaque native artifact after actual local opt-in/current fence/source guards. Server stores metadata and<=8192decoded bytes atomically after participant/original-session/current-binding rechecks; it never becomes native issuer or validates native pixels. Exact retry does not issue a different artifact.
